The '''Kerensik system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Botor Enclave/Legends|Botor Enclave]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kerensik]].
